decisions.diagnosis: The tube counter reported only zeros (flagged warning) for 12 days while nearby counters recorded normal riding, so the counts are lost and cannot be recovered.

decisions.diagnosis: Every count on this day is even and about twice the usual level, and the same happened on the same day at the nearby Metrocount tube sites 158, 164 and 168, so every bike was counted twice.
decisions.evidence: 103: 554 bikes, 0 odd of 66 non-zero slots (level 2.28); 104: 456, 0 odd of 59 (level 2.36); days either side 316/235 and 306/220; doubled() flags 158, 164, 168 on 2022-02-19 at levels 2.0-3.0.

decisions.diagnosis: The eastbound tube under-registered from 23 Nov until the counter was serviced on 13 Dec 2022 (both directions jumped back overnight), so the missed bikes cannot be recovered.
decisions.evidence: 103/104 ratio steady at 1.3-1.4 until 11-22, then 1.5-2.1 from 11-23 (104 fell 359 -> 266 while 103 stayed ~500); on 12-13 104 jumped 150 -> 494 and 163/168 ratio 1.24 -> 1.92 with no change at the neighbours; 104 PM-peak hour 33 vs 45-49 in Oct-Nov.

decisions.diagnosis: The westbound direction also under-registered in the fortnight before the 13 Dec 2022 service, dropping well below the neighbours and recovering in one step, so those counts are lost.
decisions.evidence: 163/168 ratio fell from ~1.9 to 1.16-1.3 from 11-30 and 163/158 from ~0.9 to 0.55-0.7; 103 ~300-450/day on workdays in Dec 1-12 vs 510-522 on Dec 13-15; step back up on 12-13 unmatched by neighbours.

decisions.evidence: Both directions 0 in every slot 07-12 06:00 to 07-20 14:45 after 5-6 bikes/slot at 05:00-05:45; normal ~500/day per direction either side; usual bikes in the stretch ~8700.

useful: zeros(counter=True): found the multi-day outages and the short morning blackouts (2024-07-18, Sep 2025)

directions: the weekly ratio exposed the Nov-Dec 2022 eastbound under-count, the Dec 2022 split change and the mid-2026 westbound decline

not_useful: spikes: the Friday ~22:00 eastbound bursts look like regular group rides and did not affect weekly totals
duplicates: single-record counter, nothing to find
improve: zeros: report partial-loss mornings (counts far below neighbours but not exactly 0), such as 2025-09-16

doubled: add an option to check the same dates at neighbours automatically

a per-day 'share of neighbour' series over the whole record, to spot gradual tube degradation

summary: Site 163 is a single Metrocount tube counter on the Oxford St (Bondi Junction) bike path with complete coverage from June 2021 and strong growth. Faults are counter outages (Aug 2021, Jul 2023, short mornings in 2024 and Sep 2025 after heavy rain, a feed-wide zero day in Oct 2025), a network-wide doubled day on 2022-02-19, and tube under-counting before a service on 2022-12-13 that also changed the direction split, so the series are split there. Westbound has fallen to about half its usual share since late July 2026; this is marked uncertain and still ongoing.
